passives.name: Unova Flag Bearer
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by %. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by %. The more allied sync pairs with the Unova theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by % and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is %, and the maximum damage reduction is %.)

passives.name: Extend Range
passives.description: When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets itself or an ally is successful, the target becomes all allied sync pairs. When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets an opponent is successful, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power and chance of applying additional effects of moves affected by this passive skill are not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

passives.name: Piercing Blows
passives.description:
Grants all of the following effects when the user is attacking:
Ignores the target’s passive skills that would reduce the damage of attacks.
Ignores the target’s passive skills that would protect the target against a critical hit.
Ignores the target’s Enduring effect.

passives.name: Mind Games 9
passives.description: Lowers the target’s Sp. Def by one stat rank when the user’s attack move against it is successful.
